ms.report:
The structure of `src/protocols` in the repository looks like this

```
protocols
 ├── block-fetch
 ├── chain-sync
 ├── handshake
 ├── index.ts
 ├── interfaces
 ├── keep-alive
 ├── local-state-query
 ├── local-tx-monitor
 ├── local-tx-submit
 ├── peer-sharing
 ├── tx-submission
 ├── types
 └── utils
```

each of the entry (except `index.ts`) is a directory, with the exception of `types`, `utils` and `interfaces`, each corresponds to an ouroboros miniprotocol.

in each of the miniprotocol directory you will find a `messages` folder, there you will find all the messages implementations relative to the protocol (and possibly additional data if the specific protocol requires it)

for example `src/protocols/handshake/messages` looks like this

```
messages
├── HandshakeAcceptVersion.ts
├── HandshakeMessage.ts
├── HandshakeProposeVersion.ts
├── HandshakeQueryReply.ts
├── HandshakeRefuse.ts
├── index.ts
└── RefuseReason
 ├── index.ts
 ├── RefuseReasonHandshakeDecodeError.ts
 ├── RefuseReasonRefuse.ts
 ├── RefuseReason.ts
 └── RefuseReasonVersionMismatch.ts
```

each of the entry (except `index.ts`) is a specific kind of message of the handshake miniprotocol, with respective serialization and de-serialization functions

here are the direct links to the subfolders corresponding to each protocol

block-fetch
chain-sync
handshake
keep-alive
local-state-query
local-tx-monitor
peer-sharing
tx-submission

in each of these you will find the `messages` sub folder, where the relative implementations are present
